source_row.rationale: Interdisciplinary spinal cord injury rehabilitation is important because this injury affects multiple functional domains (mobility, self-care, psychosocial adjustment), and coordinated care from nursing, physical therapy, occupational therapy, and psychology addresses this full range of needs, supported by strong evidence for improved outcomes.
source_row.source_detail: Value of Coordinated Interdisciplinary SCI Care
source_row.source_name: Consortium for Spinal Cord Medicine — Interdisciplinary SCI Rehabilitation
